title: 정정보도청구 등 사건 심판규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Cases Deemed to Be Actions Instituted)
(1) Where an action is deemed to have been instituted under Article 22 (4) of the Act, the application for mediation received by the Press Arbitration Commission shall be deemed the complaint or the application under Article 2 (1).
(2) In the case under paragraph (1), the Press Arbitration Commission shall transmit the mediation records to the competent court without delay.
(3) Where an objection to an ex officio mediation decision is withdrawn while litigation proceedings are pending, the court shall transmit to the Press Arbitration Commission the records received under paragraph (2) and the withdrawal of the objection.
